trace.question: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
trace.evidence: league that had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season refers to MAX(league_name WHERE season = '2008/2009');

attempts.sql:
SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The England Premier League had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season.
